title: S3b stale-work severity and critical-path aware steering in shadow: low continue, medium steer with changed evidence, high cancel or hold, critical-path workers first (P28, P29)
spec:
orchestrator/stale.py evidence(): add severity (none|low|medium|high) and severity_reasons: high when a moved path is in the task's write scope or is a test named in its acceptance; medium when a moved path is in its read scope or imported by a file in its write scope (use the existing repo links when available); low otherwise; none when nothing moved. orchestrator/steering_policy.py: new trigger stale_severity evaluated before dependency_changed: low continue; medium steer with a message listing the moved paths and the goal head sha; high cancel when the task has not yet committed anything in its worktree, else steer plus hold_after_gate flag (the daemon holds the task after its next gate for the Planner with hold_reason stale_high) — never auto-rebase silently for high. Critical path: daemon evaluates running tasks in critical_path.rank order and, when [steering].noncritical_medium_continue is true (default true, dated comment), a medium severity on a task not on the critical path is continue with reason noncritical. Shadow rows kind steering carry severity, critical (bool) and the would-be action; active applies. Also record for every row the accepted-task economics fields the scorecard needs later (tokens so far from the registry, elapsed). Docs: docs/hermes-hardening/12-steering-policy.md gains the severity table and the critical-path rule.
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log; test fixtures use synthetic names and values that are not credential-shaped. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Shadow-first: a new adaptive path never changes what a worker sees until its mode is active; shadow only writes decision_log or runs rows. Task worktrees carry no .orchestrator runs, tasks or decision_log state: tests use synthetic fixtures; for any measured numbers in docs run read-only against /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator via an explicit root argument. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. Contracts of the earlier modules: .orchestrator/plan.md (section GOAL T-0991) and docs/hermes-hardening/*.md on this branch; read the merged modules before building on them.
